description:
Price a question before asking it, check your credits, and look up what you can ask for: ready-made templates, interest audiences and targeting options. Never spends. Call quote first, and when a person is present show them the price and time together before you ask.

Pass action: one of quote, balance, templates, audiences, targeting. Each action takes only its own arguments.
- quote: Price a question before asking it: credits, the price, how long it will take and any fixes it needs. Never spends. Call this first, and when a person is present show them the price and time together before you ask. Arguments: question (required), currency. Read-only; needs questions:write.
- balance: Credits available, credits reserved by live questions, and what is left under this connection's daily spend cap. Check before asking something large. No other arguments. Read-only; needs account:read.
- templates: Ready-made questions at a fixed price. Pick one, fill in its options and pass its question to ask (action ask) with template_id. No sign-in needed. No other arguments. Read-only; no sign-in needed.
- audiences: Interest audiences: panels of heads who proved they ride, own, run or buy something (for example UK commuter cyclists). Put an id in question.audience to ask one instead of targeting; the price is the audience's at the minimum grade. No sign-in needed; signed in, private audiences your team sponsors are listed too. Arguments: q, country. Read-only; no sign-in needed.
- targeting: Who can answer: countries with the languages their heads read and pool size bands by tier, the age bands and genders heads declare, and the tag catalog you can target at any tier. Use the codes and tag ids in question.targeting. No sign-in needed. Arguments: language. Read-only; no sign-in needed.

action.description: What to do. One of: quote, balance, templates, audiences, targeting. Each action takes its own arguments; see the tool description.

country.description: Only audiences with heads in this country (ISO code). (Used by: audiences.)

currency.description: Currency for the price. Default: your account currency. (Used by: quote.)

language.description: Only countries whose heads read this language. (Used by: targeting.)

q.description: Words in the audience's name or summary. (Used by: audiences.)

question.description: The question. `type` picks the format; see 50heads://question-types for rules and examples. (Used by: quote.)

answered_by.description: Who answers. "heads" (default): verified people 50heads finds, priced by tier. "private": your own audience, through a link you share; people answer in the browser with no account, 5 credits an accepted answer, no tier, rush or targeting, never free text. The result says the answers were not verified by 50heads.

audience.description: Ask an interest audience instead of targeting: a panel of heads who proved they fit (estimate, action audiences). It replaces targeting, and the price per answer is the audience's at the grade, before length, format and images.

id.description: An audience id from estimate, action audiences.

min_grade.description: 1 Member (passed the questions), 2 Verified (passed more), 3 Trusted (checked by a person). Default 1.

content_flag.description: Sensitive content in the question or its images (see 50heads.com/content-policy): "medical" (injuries, conditions), "violence", "distressing" (news, disasters, death), "alcohol_gambling" or "political". Only heads who opted in see a flagged question, and it shows a content warning first. Default "none". Sexual content, nudity and hate symbols are refused.

context.description: One line of background shown under the question, only when a head needs it.

go_rule.description: Only yes_no and yes_mostly_no take a go rule. Leave it out.

language.description: Language of the question and its options, such as "en", "fr" or "pt". Heads answer in it. Omit only if it is obvious from the text.

n.description: How many heads should answer. Default 50; 100 or more for a decision.

neither.description: Add a "Neither" option at the end.

open_for_days.description: private only: days the link stays open. Default 7.

image_url.description: An https image URL or a pre-signed upload URL (POST /v1/uploads). Never inline base64.

public_results.description: Show the result on a public page: for heads, a shareable results page; for answered_by "private", the bars people see after their own answer. Default false.

reason.description: A short written "why" with every answer (10 to 140 characters): "optional" (+0.3 format) or "required" (+0.6 format). Default "off". Heads answer a little slower. Reasons come back with each answer and in the summary.

rush.description: Aim for under an hour at any size. × 1.5.
